title: ComCare denials for non-compliance with employment action plans
asked: Mr Kenneth Tiong asked how many ComCare applications were denied in the past three years for non-compliance with employment action plans, whether applicants can provide evidence of engagement with partner agencies before such denials, and whether the Ministry will ensure applicants are heard before being denied on those grounds.
response: The Minister said ComCare Short-to-Medium Term Assistance helps clients with basic living expenses while they work on improving their financial situation, and SSO officers develop action plans with clients. Action plans can be reviewed if clients face genuine difficulties or need more time, and the amount and duration of assistance may be adjusted while dependants' basic needs are met. MSF does not track the number of applicants not given ComCare because they did not comply with action plans. On the supplementary case, he said SSO is considering the appeal and the family coach has provided food rations, infant milk powder and diapers.

key_points.point: ComCare SMTA helps clients with basic living expenses while they work on improving their financial situation.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: ComCare Short-to-Medium Term Assistance (SMTA) helps clients with their basic living expenses as they work on improving their financial situation.

key_points.point: SSO officers work closely with clients to develop suitable action plans.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: Our Social Service Office (SSO) officers work closely with clients to develop suitable action plans to achieve this.

key_points.point: Clients are told at the outset that they must adhere to the action plans.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: Clients are informed at the very outset that they must adhere to these action plans.

key_points.point: Action plans can be reviewed if clients face genuine difficulties or need more time.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: However, should they face genuine difficulties meeting them or if they need more time, the action plans can be reviewed.

key_points.point: The amount and duration of SMTA may be adjusted based on adherence and progress, while dependants' basic needs are met.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: Based on the household's adherence to action plans and progress towards self-reliance, the amount and duration of the SMTA may be adjusted while ensuring dependants' basic needs are being met.

key_points.point: MSF does not track the number of applicants not given ComCare because they did not comply with action plans.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: We do not track the number of applicants who were not given ComCare because they did not comply with their action plans.

key_points.point: For the case raised, SSO is aware and is currently considering the appeal.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: For this particular case, SSO is aware and is currently considering the appeal.

key_points.point: The family coach has helped the family with food rations, infant milk powder and diapers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: for this particular family, it is a known family and the family coach has helped the family in other ways as well, including provision of food rations, infant milk powder and diapers.

key_points.point: SSO reviews cessation or tapering with a Social Assistance Officer who partnered with the family on the action plan.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: SSO reviews it with the help of the Social Assistance Officer (SAO), who has embarked and partnered with the applicant family on the action plan

key_points.point: The SAO will contact applicants for an interview and gather information from the family coach and other sources at the SMTA assessment stage.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: the SAO will contact the applicants for an interview and at the stage of assessment of the SMTA, the SAO will also get information from the family coach, from other sources of information as well

left_open: Whether applicants are given the opportunity to provide evidence of engagement with partner agencies before a denial based on non-compliance.
Whether the Ministry will ensure applicants are heard before being denied on such grounds.
supplementary: The supplementary question focused on a constituent's case where ComCare was denied over alleged non-engagement with e2i, and whether SSO verifies such claims before rejecting.
